Name: BULLET_PARAM_ST
Description: Projectiles for Npc's and the Player

Fields.Name: AtkParam ID
Fields.Description: Hitbox referenced by this bullet

Fields.Name: Projectile SFX ID
Fields.Description: Sfx attached to the bullet as it travels

Fields.Name: Impact SFX ID
Fields.Description: Sfx spawned when the bullet hits something

Fields.Name: Repel SFX ID
Fields.Description: Sfx spawned when the bullet is blocked

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: The amount of time the bullet lasts

Fields.Name: Attenuation Range
Fields.Description: Attenuation Distance, distance the bullet can travel before gravity and damage dampaning take effect

Fields.Name: Shoot Interval
Fields.Description: How often the bullet is shot when InvokeBulletBehavior is active on an animation

Fields.Name: Gravity: In Range
Fields.Description: Gravity applied before the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Gravity: Out of Range
Fields.Description: Gravity applied before the atenuantion distance

Fields.Name: Homing Stop Range
Fields.Description: The distance to the target at which to stop homing

Fields.Name: Initial Velocity
Fields.Description: Base Velocity

Fields.Name: Acceleration: In Range
Fields.Description: Acceleration within range of SFX

Fields.Name: Acceleration: Out of Range
Fields.Description: Acceleration when SFX goes out of range

Fields.Name: Max Velocity
Fields.Description: Fastest speed this bullet can travel

Fields.Name: Min Velocity
Fields.Description: Slowest speed this bullet can travel

Fields.Name: Acceleration Delay
Fields.Description: The time it takes to fully accelerate the bullet

Fields.Name: Homing Start Distance
Fields.Description: How many meters ahead do you want to start homing?

Fields.Name: Initial Hit Radius
Fields.Description: Starting size of the bullet

Fields.Name: Final Hit Radius
Fields.Description: Maximum size of the bullet

Fields.Name: Radius Spread Time
Fields.Description: Amount of time it takes for the bullet to reach the maximum size

Fields.Name: Expansion Delay
Fields.Description: Delay for the HitBulletID to spawn after the parent bullet has expired or hit something

Fields.Name: Target Point Scatter
Fields.Description: 0 is correct. Shift each component of XYZ by this amount when aiming.

Fields.Name: Shared Hit List Duration
Fields.Description: How often the bullet can hit while it is active

Fields.Name: External Force in Bullet Direction
Fields.Description: Push added every frame along the initial horizontal shooting direction. It isn't scaled by frame time. Only values above 0 apply.

Fields.Name: Shooter SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Applies speffect to the bullet owner when the bullet is shot

Fields.Name: Funnel Mode (Above 0)
Fields.Description: Any value above 0 makes this a funnel bullet: it registers with the funnel targeting system, and with Follow Type 1 it is placed in a ring around the shooter (Funnel Formation Radius and Height). For player shooters the funnel count comes from Intelligence (up to 14: 1, 15-18: 2, 19-24: 3, 25-30: 4, 31+: 5) unless Funnel Count Ignores Intelligence is on. Only "above 0" matters; the ID itself isn't used as an NpcThinkParam row.

Fields.Name: Hit Bullet ID
Fields.Description: Bullet that spawns based on the launchConditionType

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [0]
Fields.Description: Applies this spEffect when the bullets hits a character

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [1]
Fields.Description: Applies this spEffect when the bullets hits a character

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [2]
Fields.Description: Applies this spEffect when the bullets hits a character

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [3]
Fields.Description: Applies this spEffect when the bullets hits a character

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [4]
Fields.Description: Applies this spEffect when the bullets hits a character

Fields.Name: Bullet Count
Fields.Description: The number of projectiles fired at once

Fields.Name: Homing Angle
Fields.Description: The amount of corrections applied to the bullet trajectory every second

Fields.Name: Launch Angle
Fields.Description: Offsets the angle the bullet is shot at in degrees on the Y axis, Negative # = Shoot right/Positive # = Shoot left

Fields.Name: Launch Angle Interval
Fields.Description: The amount of degrees each bullet will be offset relative to the one that came before when shooting multiple bullets (Y axis)

Fields.Name: Launch Elevation Interval
Fields.Description: The amount of degrees each bullet will be offset relative to the one that came before when shooting multiple bullets (X axis)

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Physical
Fields.Description: Reduces physical damage of the bullet when the bullet travels past the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Magic
Fields.Description: Reduces magic damage of the bullet when the bullet travels past the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Fire
Fields.Description: Reduces fire damage of the bullet when the bullet travels past the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Reduces lightning damage of the bullet when the bullet travels past the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Stamina
Fields.Description: Reduces stamina damage of the bullet when the bullet travels past the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Knockback
Fields.Description: Reduces knockback damage of the bullet when the bullet travels past the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Launch Elevation Angle
Fields.Description: Offsets the angle the bullet is shot at in degrees on the X axis, Negative # = Shoot right/Positive # = Shoot left

Fields.Name: Lock Direction Limit Angle
Fields.Description: At launch, the bullet turns toward the target by at most this many degrees. 0: no turn toward the target.

Fields.Name: Can Penetrate
Fields.Description: Can the bullet travel through characters and objects?

Fields.Name: Previous Velocity Direction Rate
Fields.Description: Ratio to add the previous movement direction to the current direction when the sliding bullet hits the wall

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute
Fields.Description: Physical damage type

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: Non-physical damage type

Fields.Name: Material Attack Type
Fields.Description: Overrides the attack type used for hit sounds and effects. 254: keep the attack's value.

Fields.Name: Material Size
Fields.Description: 'Size' of attack.

Fields.Name: Launch Condition Type
Fields.Description: Determines the conditions required for HitBulletID to spawn

Fields.Name: Follow Type
Fields.Description: What the bullet moves with. 0: nothing. 1: the shooter's dummy poly. 2: the shooter's feet, one-to-one. 3: the target point (the lock-on target, or the aim point ahead). 4: nothing; the bullet hugs the ground instead. 5: the middle of the shooter's body.

Fields.Name: Is Hit SFX Stuck to Target
Fields.Description: Sets whether bullets such as arrows remain stuck in the character

Fields.Name: Is Continuous Hit
Fields.Description: Sets the continuous-hit flag on the bullet's attack hits. Its exact effect isn't established.

Fields.Name: Is Penetrate Map
Fields.Description: Can the bullet travel through the map?

Fields.Name: Is Hit Both Teams
Fields.Description: Will it hit both enemies and allies? (Does not hit wandering ghosts)

Fields.Name: Is Use Shared Hit List
Fields.Description: On: all bullets of this ID fired by one emitter (a volley, or repeated volleys) share one hit list, so each target is hit once by the whole group. The list lasts for Shared Hit List Duration.

Fields.Name: Use Multiple Dummy Polys for Placement
Fields.Description: Do you use the same Damipoly ID more than once when placing bullets?
Whether to send an interrupt notification to AI (INTERUPT_FLAG_Shoot)

Fields.Name: Apply Curvature Correction
Fields.Description: Apply curvature correction

Fields.Name: Is Pushed by Force Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is pushed away by bullets with Attach Effect Type 1 (wind barriers and similar).

Fields.Name: Ignore Map Hits After Water
Fields.Description: Ignore the effect if it hits the surface of the water

Fields.Name: Ignore Water Surface Hits
Fields.Description: Ignore state transitions even when hit by water

Fields.Name: Is Pushed by Dark Force Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is pushed away by bullets with Attach Effect Type 3 (magic-repelling barriers).

Fields.Name: Damage Calculation Side
Fields.Description: Damage calculation side.　In multiplayer, for switching the damage calculation between the giving side and the receiving side

Fields.Name: Is Auto Homing Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether to automatically follow when unlocked

Fields.Name: Recalculate Placement for Synced Bullets
Fields.Description: In the case of synchronously generated bullets, the synchronous emitter attitude is used without recalculating the attitude based on the dummy poly position when the bullet is generated

Fields.Name: Do Emitted Bullets Lock-on to Target
Fields.Description: If bullets are created at regular intervals, should they be shot at the target? If OFF, fly to the parent posture

Fields.Name: Is SFX Inherited by Child Bullet
Fields.Description: Takes over the SFX of the parent bullet. Ignore the SFXID set for submunitions

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Holy
Fields.Description: Reduces dark damage of the bullet when the bullet travels past the attenuation distance

Fields.Name: Bullet SFX Delete Type - By Hit
Fields.Description: Bullet SFX disappearance type when landing or repelling

Fields.Name: Bullet SFX Delete Type - By Expiration
Fields.Description: Bullet SFX disappearance type when the duration expires

Fields.Name: Target Vertical Offset
Fields.Description: Vertical offset of the impact position. Shifts the target position up and down when firing and homing

Fields.Name: Random Launch Angle - Max
Fields.Description: Random horizontal spread in degrees: each bullet's angle varies by up to ± half this value.

Fields.Name: Random Elevation Angle - Max
Fields.Description: Random elevation spread in degrees: each bullet's elevation varies by up to ± half this value.

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Bullet ID
Fields.Description: Bullet that is spawned from this bullet over the duration of this bullet

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Min Interval
Fields.Description: Maximum amount of time to wait for before create another bullet via intervalCreateBulletId

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Max Interval
Fields.Description: Minimum amount of time to wait for before create another bullet via intervalCreateBulletId

Fields.Name: Prediction Shoot Observe Time
Fields.Description: Leads the target: the aim uses the target's average velocity over this many seconds. 0: no lead.

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Start Delay
Fields.Description: Wait time before starting to make bullets at regular intervals

Fields.Name: SFX Posture Type
Fields.Description: Set the initial pose of the SFX created from the bullet or sub-bullet

Fields.Name: Create Limit Group ID
Fields.Description: When creating bullets set to the same group Id, if the limit is reached, the bullet will not be created
When guarding a bullet, where to take the guard success judgment position

Fields.Name: Is Speed Inherited by Child Bullet
Fields.Description: The speed of the parent bullet will be inherited to the bullet spawned by the parent

Fields.Name: Is SFX Disabled on Chr/Object Hit
Fields.Description: On: no impact effect, impact sound or hit asset when the bullet hits a character or object. Map hits still play them.

Fields.Name: Is Wall Checked by Center Ray
Fields.Description: There was a problem with the digging judgment when firing a bullet, so it is for error handling.

Fields.Name: Is Erased by Erase Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is ended, with its hit effect, by bullets with Attach Effect Type 4 (Erase Bullets).

Fields.Name: Is Bullet Wall Filter Used
Fields.Description: On: the bullet's map checks use a different collision filter (meant for collision that only bullets see).

Fields.Name: Funnel Count Ignores Intelligence
Fields.Description: On: funnel bullets fired by players use Bullet Count instead of the Intelligence-based count (see Funnel Mode).

Fields.Name: Emitter Source Radius
Fields.Description: Radius in metres for Emitter Source Type 1 (around the shooter) and 4 (around the nearest enemy).
Creates the specified object when the bullet is shot

Fields.Name: Duration - Random Range
Fields.Description: Add a random number of seconds with the set time amplitude to the lifetime
Posture damage type

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Type
Fields.Description: A field this bullet puts on other bullets while it flies. 1 pushes away, 2 ends, 3 pushes away, 4 erases, 5 absorbs, 6 remotely detonates. Only bullets with the matching flag are affected (Is Pushed by Force Fields, Is Ended by Flare Fields, Is Pushed by Dark Force Fields, Is Erased by Erase Fields, Is Absorbed by Absorb Fields, Can be Remotely Detonated).

Fields.Name: Force Erase SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect played when the bullet is ended or absorbed by another bullet's field. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Bullet SFX Delete Type - By Force Erase
Fields.Description: How the bullet effect ends when the bullet is absorbed by another bullet's field: 0 stops its emitter (existing particles finish), 1 deletes it.

Fields.Name: Homing Angle: X
Fields.Description: Only the X-axis component of the inductive performance is changed. Do not change with -1
If the bullet's spawn point is more than this distance away from the owner's position, it will not be fired

Fields.Name: Vertical Firing Angle: Minimum
Fields.Description: For curvature correction_Minimum firing elevation angle [deg]

Fields.Name: Vertical Firing Angle: Maximum
Fields.Description: For curvature correction_Maximum firing elevation angle [deg]

Fields.Name: Initial Velocity: Minimum
Fields.Description: The minimum initial velocity the bullet can have.

Fields.Name: Initial Velocity: Maximum
Fields.Description: The maximum initial velocity the bullet can have.

Fields.Name: Is Absorbed by Absorb Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is absorbed by bullets with Attach Effect Type 5: it ends without its hit effect and counts as absorbed (Launch Condition Type 6).
When the bullet approaches the specified value (m) from the guidance target, the bullet disappears
